searchText: MSRP $209,608. New 2027 Entegra Odyssey 30Z Luxury Class C RV. Optional Features Coastal Decor Customer Value Package E-Z Drive Automotive-bonded Panoramic Window in Front Cap with Power Shade Frameless Windows Heated Holding Tanks Electric Patio Awning with LED Lights Black Tank Flush Sony Infotainment Center with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Backup and Side-View Cameras LED HD Smart TV in Living Area Esteem Package Full Body Paint Slam-latch Baggage Doors EZ-Drive Elite: all EZ-Drive features plus Koni FSD Shocks and a heavy-duty rear stabilizer bar Upgraded sideview mirrors Hydraulic Leveling Jacks Solid Surface Counters Dual ACs Bedroom TV Blackout Appearance 200W Roof Mounted Solar Panel w/ 2nd House Battery Power Theater Seats  The Odyssey features a one-piece seamless fiberglass roof, front and rear stabilizer bars, Hellwig Helper springs, and the all-new Ford® V8 and E-450 chassis. You will also love the Entegra Coach Odyssey's amazing molded front fiberglass cap that distinguishes this class C from any other on the market today. The distinctive design also enables the front cab-over to feature a huge built-in skylight with power shade. Just push a button and let Mother Nature light up the beautiful interior décor and gaze at the stars at the end of a fun-filled day. New for 2027 includes 42K BTU Suburban On-Demand HW Heater, auto gen start, added ducting to FOHB, New Paint option, Esteem Package and Dune Gray painted cabinets or Coastal decor wood.
